fidelity_methodology.interval_interpretation: conditional Monte Carlo quantiles under observed exposure and same-sample empirical rates; not prediction intervals or external coverage
fidelity_methodology.primary_peak_stage_distance: minimum index distance between any observed and simulated-p50 peak stage, where peaks use primary-topic share of all stage posts and all exact ties are retained
fidelity_methodology.primary_stage_scale_wape: sum over stages of abs(simulated p50 primary count - observed primary count), divided by total observed primary count
fidelity_methodology.primary_tail_share_error: absolute difference in decay-stage share of the four-stage primary topic count total
fidelity_methodology.simulation_quantiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over seeded replicate counts
fidelity_methodology.topic_incidence_composition_tvd: one half of the L1 distance between observed and simulated-p50 distributions of declared topic-hit counts aggregated over stages; topic hits may overlap and are not population shares
